questions.question: Zašto je Intel u FY2024 imao veliki gubitak, prema njegovom 10-K izveštaju?
questions.question_en: Why did Intel report a large loss in FY2024, according to its 10-K?

key_points: $9.9B non-cash tax charge, substantially related to valuation allowances on US net deferred tax assets
$2.8B restructuring charges from the 2024 Restructuring Plan (~15% core workforce reduction)
$3.3B non-cash impairments and accelerated depreciation of manufacturing assets (mostly Intel 7 node)
$3.1B non-cash impairment of goodwill and certain acquired intangible assets
expected_explanation.must_include: valuation allowance on deferred tax assets (najveća pojedinačna stavka)

expected_citation.filing: Intel 10-K za period koji se završava 2024-12-28, podnet 2025-01-31 (accn 0000050863-25-000009)
expected_citation.section: Item 7 MD&A -> Overview -> 'A Year in Review' i 'Restructuring'; detalji u Note 7 (Restructuring and Other Charges) i Note 8 (Income Taxes)

questions.question: Šta je, prema 10-K izveštaju, pokretalo rast prihoda NVIDIA-e u FY2024?
questions.question_en: According to its 10-K, what drove NVIDIA's revenue growth in FY2024?

key_points: Data Center revenue $47.5B, up 217% (Data Center compute up 244%, Networking up 133%)
Strong demand from enterprise software and consumer internet applications and multiple industry verticals (automotive, financial services, healthcare)
AI platforms built on Hopper / Grace Hopper / Ada for generative AI and LLM workloads; ~40% of Data Center revenue estimated to be AI inference
Large cloud providers were more than half of Data Center revenue in Q4 FY2024
Gaming up 15% (channel inventory normalization) - minor contributor
expected_explanation.must_include: Data Center segment as the main driver

expected_citation.filing: NVIDIA 10-K za period koji se završava 2024-01-28, podnet 2024-02-21 (accn 0001045810-24-000029)
expected_citation.section: Item 7 MD&A -> 'Fiscal Year 2024 Summary' i opis Data Center segmenta

questions.question: Zašto je Micron u FY2023 imao gubitak, prema njegovom 10-K izveštaju?
questions.question_en: Why did Micron report a loss in FY2023, according to its 10-K?

key_points: Memory and storage industry deteriorated sharply: weak end-market demand, macroeconomic challenges, customers reducing inventory levels
Significant declines in average selling prices: DRAM high-40s %, NAND low-50s %; total revenue down 49%
$1.83B inventory write-downs to net realizable value
$382M facility underutilization costs from reduced wafer starts
expected_explanation.must_include: ASP (price) declines for DRAM/NAND driven by weak demand / customer inventory reduction

expected_citation.filing: Micron 10-K za period koji se završava 2023-08-31, podnet 2023-10-06 (accn 0000723125-23-000054)
expected_citation.section: Item 7 MD&A -> Overview -> 'Industry Conditions'; Results of Operations -> 'Total Revenue' i 'Consolidated Gross Margin'
